# The tools CircleCI's hosted MCP server documents in the Supported tools table of circleci.com/docs/guides/toolkit/circleci-mcp-overview/
# (last_updated 2026-09-28), one per line. CircleCI-Public/mcp-server-circleci is the deprecated local server and not this one.
# Each line is a tool as its server names it and whether it only reads or changes something.
hello read
list_runs read
get_run read
list_workflows read
get_workflow read
rerun_workflow change
cancel_workflow change
list_jobs read
get_job read
get_job_logs read
list_artifacts read
list_job_tests read
download_usage_data change
